introHtml: Custom lanyards with carabiner attachments offer a secure and convenient way to keep ID badges, keys, or access cards within reach. The carabiner clip allows users to quickly attach and detach items from belts, bags, or loops—perfect for busy environments like trade shows, hospitals, or construction sites. Choose from various materials and imprint methods to match your brand colors and logo.
